parole.testo: Ultimately (by way of a European language) from Classical Persian لاک (lāk), from Sanskrit लाक्षा (lākṣā).
Unclear. Perhaps reshaped from dialectal мингу́ш (mingúš, “earring”) + -ар (-ar), from Classical Persian مَنْگوش (mangōš, “earring”).
